title: Army Art Collection
content: This painting by Mead Schaeffer is part of the Army Art collection, which is stored in a large warehouse 30 minutes outside of Washington, and is rarely seen by the public.Many of the paintings were made by servicemen on duty who were an eyewitness to dramatic world events. Others were commissioned pieces for posters and other publications.The collection also includes a few Norman Rockwell originals.Lots more photos at Buzzfeed:Benny Johnson--Inside the Army's Spectacular Hidden Treasure RoomThanks, Tex/Ed
